Seeing that, Hosoda grinned.
"You just got bitten by the bug, didn't you?"
He said it, his shoulders shaking with delight.
What should I do?
If being bitten causes a change in {f:my|my} body...
"My story ends here..."
Hosoda picked up the Sanbura tea bug and murmured, truly delighted.
"{a}{f:|}, whose story are you going to hear next?"
{f:Oh no|Oh no}.
For a while, {f:I|I} couldn't say anything.
......
But...
{f:I|I} {f:didn't drink|never drank} the Sanbura tea.
Nothing strange {f:should happen.|is going to happen, right?}
It's fine.
I'm sure it's {f:fine|fine}...
{f:I|I} decided to hear the next person's story, though a lump of unease stayed in my chest.
"Well then, the next story..."{p}
rows.24:acc4:
When I looked inside, the plant...
The plant with Takeuchi's face was crying.
The Takeuchi in human form wasn't there anymore.
And the plant was saying something like this:
"Help me...!
I'm Takeuchi.
An evil spirit turned me into this.
Help me... please... help me..."
He told me the whole story.
On the first day Takeuchi came to this school, he snuck into the old school building as a prank.
While he was there, he needed to use the restroom...
When he used that toilet, an evil spirit's hand came out of the bowl and grabbed his leg, it seems.
The evil spirit sucked the life energy out of Takeuchi's body.
And Takeuchi was turned into a plant, he said.
After that, the evil spirit took on Takeuchi's exact form...
And started coming to school in his place, he told me.
Every so often, the evil spirit would come to Takeuchi and suck out his life energy.
It drained the energy out of Takeuchi, that shriveled-up plant, like it was wringing him dry.
I guess evil spirits don't relieve themselves at all.
That's why Takeuchi got the reputation of never going to the restroom.
Nobody must have known he'd been making trips to the old school building's restroom.
Takeuchi, now a plant, was wailing.
But there was nothing I could do.
I apologized to him over and over, and left the old school building's restroom behind...{p}
